dmp.title: Effects of Placental Dysfunction on Brain Growth in Congenital Heart Disease
dmp.description: The proposed project will involve human participants and will acquire demographic, clinical, fetal/placental magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), genomic, and placental tissue data from 225 pregnant women with a fetal diagnosis of CHD and 115 pregnant women with a healthy fetus. This study involves eight co-investigators from three sites, Washington University in St. Louis (WUSTL), Boston Children's Hospital (BCH), and The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids).
dmp.ethical_issues_description: The project involves human participants. Informed consent documents will include language describing data management and sharing plans. Personal identifying information will be removed. Data will be deidentified by removing all 18 HIPAA identifiers prior to sharing. The study will have a Certificate of Confidentiality from NIH.

project.title: Effects of Placental Dysfunction on Brain Growth in Congenital Heart Disease
project.description: Study across Washington University in St. Louis, Boston Children's Hospital, and The Hospital for Sick Children.

dataset.title: Demographic and clinical data
dataset.description: Demographic data include maternal age, race, ethnicity, fetal sex, and socioeconomics (zip code, insurance type). Clinical data include cardiac diagnosis, details of pregnancy and fetal complications, and details of infant postnatal course. Demographic and clinical data will be captured by each site into the REDCap secure electronic data capture system (EDC) and will generate approximately 5 GB of data.
dataset.preservation_statement: Demographic and clinical data entered into the REDCap EDC system will be cleaned, de-identified, preserved and shared.
data_quality_assurance: Dr. Ortinau will meet monthly with key study personnel to ensure the timeliness of data entry and review data to ensure the quality of data entry.

security_and_privacy.title: Controlled access and de-identification
security_and_privacy.description: Each user will be given role specific access to the EDC system, and access will be controlled by granting users individual usernames and passwords. Appropriate measures such as assigning a study identification number and removal of all dates will be used for data de-identification and sharing.

security_and_privacy.title: Human subjects protection
security_and_privacy.description: All research participants will be consented for broad data sharing. Data will be deidentified by removing all 18 HIPAA identifiers prior to sharing, and the study will have a Certificate of Confidentiality from NIH.

distribution.title: De-identified demographic and clinical data distribution
distribution.description: All de-identified demographic and clinical data will be shared via the institutional repository Digital Commons@Becker. Data will be made publicly available with controlled access under Data Use Agreement to ensure the safety of participants' data.

host.title: Digital Commons@Becker
host.description: Digital Commons@Becker provides metadata, persistent identifiers (DOIs), and long-term access. It is administered and maintained by the Bernard Becker Medical Library, hosted by bepress, and backed up by S3 cloud storage. The repository can host multiple file types, conducts regular audits for fixity and authenticity, and plans exist in instances of repository host change.

metadata.description: A data dictionary will be generated and deposited into a repository along with all shared datasets. A README file will also be generated and deposited into the repository and will include instructions for data analysis.

dataset.title: Fetal and placental MRI data
dataset.description: MRI data include regional fetal brain MRI measures, placental oxygenation measures, and MR oximetry. MRI data will be captured by each site into the Central Neuroimaging Data Archive at WUSTL.
dataset.preservation_statement: MRI data will be preserved and shared via OpenNeuro after images are defaced. Raw data will not be shared due to the potential risk of identifying the fetus.
data_quality_assurance: Datasets are audited systematically to ensure that the bits are maintained exactly as deposited, and a log of preservation actions is kept to help ensure the content’s integrity.

security_and_privacy.title: Defacing and raw data restriction
security_and_privacy.description: MRI data will be shared via OpenNeuro after images are defaced. Raw data will not be shared due to the potential risk of identifying the fetus.

security_and_privacy.title: Embargo and authentication
security_and_privacy.description: After an optional 36-month embargo period, datasets are published into the public domain. Prior to being made public, access to a dataset is controlled through strict authentication policies and an isolated storage backend.

distribution.title: MRI data distribution via OpenNeuro
distribution.description: MRI data will be deposited into OpenNeuro. Metadata describing each dataset snapshot is indexed for searching, and copies of ingested content are provided via persistent DOIs minted for each version of a dataset.

license.start_date: 36 months after the first successful version of the dataset

host.title: OpenNeuro
host.description: Digital content ingested to OpenNeuro is replicated multiple times and stored in geo-diverse locations on different media types. The repository is built using widely-adopted and actively maintained open-source data management tools. These tools permit changes to content to be tracked and snapshots to be made that uniquely identify specific points in the lifetime of each dataset.
host.backup_type: replicated multiple times in geo-diverse locations on different media types

metadata.description: MRI data will be standardized using the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) recommendations. Metadata describing each dataset snapshot is indexed for searching.

technical_resource.name: Fetal brain analysis software
technical_resource.description: The software and algorithms used for fetal brain analysis are distributed as open source software and shared through a GitHub repository (bchimagine).

technical_resource.name: Placental MRI methods
technical_resource.description: Placental MRI methods are readily available and can be provided by contacting the research team.

dataset.title: Genomic data
dataset.description: Genomic data will be individual level data. Analysis of genomic DNA will link genotype to phenotypic information obtained as part of this study. Genomic data will include trio whole exome sequencing (WES) for a total of 20 TB data.
dataset.preservation_statement: The study will be registered in dbGaP at the time of data cleaning and quality control measure initiation. Genomic data will be shared and deposited into dbGaP according to GDS policy, which requires that genomic data must be submitted within 3 months following data generation and released within 6 months of data submission to the repository or at acceptance of the publication, whichever is first.
data_quality_assurance: The study will be registered in dbGaP at the time of data cleaning and quality control measure initiation.

security_and_privacy.title: Controlled access for individual-level data
security_and_privacy.description: For dbGaP, summary level data is open but credentialed user must apply for access to individual level data.

distribution.title: Genomic data distribution via dbGaP
distribution.description: WES and phenotype data will be uploaded using the dbGaP submission guide and templates.

host.title: dbGaP
host.description: Datasets in dbGaP will be findable through the study accession number which is a unique, stable, and versioned identifier that can be used in publications.

metadata.description: Genomic data will be in CRAM format with alignment to the latest reference genome and variant files in VCF format. Submission uses the dbGaP submission guide and templates.

dataset.title: Placental tissue data
dataset.description: Placental tissue data include qualitative clinical assessment and confocal laser scanning microscopy. Placental tissue will be maintained in the Pathology Department at WUSTL, with additional slides for confocal laser scanning microscopy maintained in a secure laboratory environment managed by one of the co-investigators.
dataset.preservation_statement: Placental data entered into the REDCap EDC system will be cleaned, de-identified, preserved and shared.

security_and_privacy.title: Secure laboratory environment
security_and_privacy.description: Additional slides for confocal laser scanning microscopy will be maintained in a secure laboratory environment managed by one of the co-investigators.

distribution.title: Placental tissue data distribution
distribution.description: All de-identified placental tissue data will be shared via the institutional repository Digital Commons@Becker.

host.title: Digital Commons@Becker
host.description: Institutional repository for presenting and preserving scholarly work created at Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis.

metadata.description: A data dictionary and README file will be generated and deposited into a repository along with all shared datasets.

technical_resource.name: Placental MRI methods
technical_resource.description: Placental MRI methods are readily available and can be provided by contacting the research team.
